item.title: MY TURN: The biological prescription schools are ignoring
item.description: In the ongoing debate surrounding America’s metabolic crisis, we have reached a bizarre cultural paradox. On one side, we are witnessing the medicalization of appetite: millions of adults are turning to GLP-1 receptor agonists like Ozempic and Wegovy to synthetically force their bodies into feeling full. On the other, public health dialogue remains stubbornly fixated on lecturing individuals about willpower.
